S021.name: Disorganized_Thinking_Speech
S021.description: Symptoms where speech or thought appears scattered and difficult to follow due to a lack of logical or consistent flow.

subtypes.Derailment or Loose Associations: A speech pattern of switching rapidly from one topic to another with no logical connection between thoughts.
subtypes.Tangentiality: Speech that deviates entirely from the question and fails to answer directly.
subtypes.Incoherence or Word Salad: Severe fragmentation of speech and sentence structure, making it nearly impossible to understand.
subtypes.Neologisms: Using made-up words that have meaning only to the individual.
subtypes.Clang Associations: Speech governed by sounds, such as rhyming, rather than the meaning of words.

S022.name: Disorganized_Abnormal_Behavior
S022.description: A state where behavior and motor control are severely disturbed, appearing as movements or reactions inappropriate to the situation.

subtypes.Childlike Silliness: Inappropriate, childish, or illogical behavior appearing in situations.
subtypes.Stupor: No psychomotor activity; not actively relating to environment.
subtypes.Catalepsy: Passive induction of a posture held against gravity.
subtypes.Waxy Flexibility: Slight, even resistance to positioning by examiner.
subtypes.Mutism: No, or very little, verbal response despite the ability to speak.
subtypes.Negativism: Opposition or no response to instructions or external stimuli without apparent motive.
subtypes.Posturing: Spontaneous and active maintenance of a posture against gravity.
subtypes.Mannerism: Odd, circumstantial caricature of normal actions.
subtypes.Agitation: Excessive motor activity without obvious external cause.
subtypes.Grimacing: Contorted facial expressions irrelevant to the situation.

symptom.disease_info: Schizophrenia is a chronic psychotic disorder defined by sustained disturbances in thought organization, perception, behavior, and functioning, with symptoms persisting for at least six months and causing meaningful social or occupational impairment. Its course often emerges gradually, and it is distinguished from brief psychotic disorder or mood disorders with psychotic features by duration, functional decline, and the absence of psychosis occurring only during mood episodes.

patient.stressor: When a new district manager began tightening expectations around inventory forecasts and shift scheduling, Mark’s long-standing reputation as the dependable, talkative supervisor was challenged for the first time in years. Over the next 11 months, his once-flexible explanations in meetings became increasingly hard for coworkers to follow, and his on-the-floor decisions grew erratic enough that associates stopped relying on his directions during busy weekends. The strain spilled into his home routines, with missed community commitments and awkward disruptions at church barbecues making his wife recognize this was more than ordinary work stress. After a tense performance review and a near-suspension, Mark accepted an employee-assistance referral that led to psychiatric evaluation.

S021.manifestation: I came in because when I try to explain inventory numbers or the weekend schedule, my words start jumping from trucks to Thursdays to the church grill to my boss’s tone, and people look at me like they can’t follow what I’m saying.

S022.name: Disorganized_Abnormal_Behavior
S022.description: A state where behavior and motor control are severely disturbed, appearing as movements or reactions inappropriate to the situation.
S022.manifestation: Sometimes on the sales floor I catch myself pacing the same aisle, straightening the same row of batteries over and over, or just standing there with the schedule clipboard in my hand while the associates are waiting for me to tell them what to do.

add_requirements.functional_impairment: I’m not trusted to run busy weekend shifts anymore, and after the performance review my boss warned me I could be suspended if things don’t improve. At home, my wife has had to cover commitments I used to handle because people started getting uncomfortable or confused around me.
add_requirements.duration: This has been building for about 11 months, since the new district manager started pushing harder on forecasts and schedules.
add_requirements.psychotic_symptoms_duration: The jumbled explanations and odd stops on the sales floor have been noticeable for about six months now.
